Hi,

I am using the IRACE software to perform the parameter tunning of my algorithm. I am using IRACE in the batch mode, I mean, I adapted the file "target-runner-slurm" from the directory "examples", I am also using the file "target-evaluator".

Attached I send you the file "target-evaluator" that I am using. My question is if IRACE will execute correctly if I comment (or remove) the following line:

TODELETE=$(comm -23 <(ls -1 c*-${INSTANCEID}-${SEED}.* | sort) <(ls -1 $ALLFILES))

I was examining the performance of the script "target-evaluator" and I think there is no problem if I remove this line, since I want to preserve the files. For this reason, my question is, Will IRACE run correctly if I remove or comment this line?


Regards.
Fernando.
